propositions: Container Dockerfiles (mcp, reviewbot, opcert) pull uv from floating :latest tag while pyproject.toml pins required-version to exactly 0.12.7, causing build failures when upstream publishes 0.12.9.
Every docker compose build fails at uv sync with 'Required uv version ==0.12.7 does not match the running version 0.12.9', blocking all autodeploy ticks and escalating backoff.
The CI action setup-uv pins uv correctly, but three Dockerfiles were left behind using floating :latest, creating a time bomb that fires on any upstream release.
The uv version pin must be single-sourced to prevent drift; a gate must detect floating :latest tags for version-sensitive toolchain images.
MCP container is separately OOM-killed and cannot rebuild; reviewbot and opcert containers serve stale images but their builds are equally broken, risking a second outage on restart or reboot.
